name: DynamicServiceTable
description: A reusable dynamic table widget that renders SQL query results with server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering for IBM Business Automation Workflow

configOptions.name: showRecordCount
configOptions.label: Show Record Count
configOptions.description: Display total record count in header

configOptions.name: enableRowSelection
configOptions.label: Enable Row Selection
configOptions.description: Allow users to click rows to select them

configOptions.name: styleTheme
configOptions.label: Style Theme
configOptions.description: Visual theme for the table (default or modern)

configOptions.name: enableSearch
configOptions.label: Enable Search
configOptions.description: Enable client-side search within loaded data

configOptions.name: onSort
configOptions.label: On Sort
configOptions.description: Event fired when column header is clicked for sorting

configOptions.name: onPageChange
configOptions.label: On Page Change
configOptions.description: Event fired when page navigation occurs

configOptions.name: onPageSizeChange
configOptions.label: On Page Size Change
configOptions.description: Event fired when rows per page is changed

configOptions.name: onRowSelect
configOptions.label: On Row Select
configOptions.description: Event fired when a row is clicked

configOptions.name: onRefresh
configOptions.label: On Refresh
configOptions.description: Event fired when refresh button is clicked
